title: Indecent Literature - Letter From Kelly And Walsh Limited

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.5, Special Branch
REPORT
Date August 16, 1940
Subject Indecent Literature - Letter from Kelly & Walsh Limited.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Supt. Mason

In pursuance of instructions by
D.C. (Special Branch), relating to the attached letter
from Mr. S.C. Gregory, manager of Kelly and Walsh
Limited, a visit was paid to that company at 9 a.m.
August 15, 1940.
Mr. Gregory, when asked for details
of the claim made in his letter of August 12, stated
that the books in question, a series, published by the
Obelisk Press, Paris, included "The Honey-Moon Night",
"A Night in a Harem" etc. and were on sale at the
Williams Book Store, F.B.226 Avenue Haig. A visit
was paid to the bookstore at 2.20 p.m. with the motive
of obtaining one of the offending copies for
examination. A careful scrutiny of the books set
out for sale was made, but none of the books mentioned
were found.
However, one copy "Ideal Marriage", a
book on the subject of sex, published by the
International Book Company, Room 713, House 113,
Kiukiang Road, was found. This firm was successfully
prosecuted by Central Station under Crime Register
No. 3210/39, the proprietor Tsang Chi-tang (張志堂)
being fined $150 and 9 copies of the book being
confiscated.
The proprietor of the Williams Book
Store voluntarily handed over the copy for which a
receipt was issued and the owner warned that such books
were undesirable.
D. C. (Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别课 S.5
报告
日期：1940年8月16日
事由：淫秽出版物——凯利与沃尔什有限公司（Kelly & Walsh Limited）来信
呈报人：副督察长（D.S.I.）戈尔德（Golder） 转呈人：警司梅森（Mason）

遵照特别课副巡捕房帮办（D.C. (Special Branch)）关于所附凯利与沃尔什有限公司经理 S.C. 格雷戈里（S.C. Gregory）先生来信的指示，于1940年8月15日上午9时造访了该公司。

当被问及他在8月12日信中所提指控的细节时，格雷戈里先生称，涉案书籍为巴黎方尖碑出版社（Obelisk Press）出版的一套丛书，包括《蜜月之夜》（"The Honey-Moon Night"）、《后宫一夜》（"A Night in a Harem"）等，并在海格路226号（F.B.226 Avenue Haig）的威廉姆斯书店（Williams Book Store）有售。下午2时20分，为了获取一本违禁样本以供检查，对该书店进行了走访。对陈列出售的书籍进行了仔细审查，但未发现上述提及的任何书籍。

然而，发现了一本名为《理想婚姻》（"Ideal Marriage"）的书籍，这是一本关于性主题的书籍，由九江路113号713室的国际图书公司（International Book Company）出版。中央捕房曾依据犯罪登记号 3210/39 成功起诉该商行，店主张志堂（Tsang Chi-tang）被罚款150元，并没收该书9本。

威廉姆斯书店店主自愿交出了该书样本，已出具收据，并警告店主此类书籍是不受欢迎的。

特别课副巡捕房帮办（D. C. (Special Branch)）

KELLY & WALSH LIMITED
BOOKSELLERS PRINTERS PUBLISHERS STATIONERS
30 NANKING ROAD SHANGHAI

CHINA
August 12, 1940

The Commissioner of Police,
Central Police Station,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

From time to time, we have seen reports in
the local Press that your Office has been instrumental
in seizing and preventing distribution of indecent
literature in the International Settlement. This has
been we imagine mainly Chinese publications, and we
are not certain whether the Chinese laws under which
you would act apply to publications in the English lan-
guage. We feel however we should report to you the wide-
spread appearance of a number of books in the English
language, which are banned in England and in America,
and which have hitherto been sold in Shanghai only in the
French Bookshop. They have been printed in Paris and their
sale in a French-owned concern would be legal. These new
editions are however pirated copies, printed in Shanghai,
and sold at the many shops that sell pirated books. We
should be interested to know whether you feel any action
could be taken to seize these under the same laws that
apply to indecent publications in the Chinese language.

Yours faithfully,
KELLY & WALSH LTD

Manager

L
page_data.zh:
凯利与沃尔什有限公司
书商 印刷商 出版商 文具商
上海南京路30号

中国
1940年8月12日

致警务处处长，
中央捕房，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

我们不时在当地报刊上看到报道，称贵处在查扣和阻止淫秽出版物在国际租界内分发方面发挥了作用。我们想象这主要是中文出版物，且我们不确定适用于贵处执法的中国法律是否适用于英文出版物。然而，我们认为应向贵处报告，大量英文书籍广泛出现，这些书籍在英国和美国是被禁止的，且此前仅在上海的法文书店出售。这些书籍在巴黎印刷，在法资企业销售是合法的。然而，这些新版本是在上海印刷的盗版副本，并在许多销售盗版书的商店出售。我们希望了解，贵处是否认为可以依据适用于中文淫秽出版物的相同法律，采取行动查扣这些书籍。

此致
敬礼，

凯利与沃尔什有限公司

经理

L
